text: {"name":"patch_extract_ext_payload","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates the stored extension-patch block and copies requested payload fragments to the output buffer, returning status codes for invalid data, no matching flags, or insufficient capacity.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"requested_flags","a2":"output_buffer","a3":"output_capacity","v6":"bytes_copied"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Extension-patch block magic value"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Extension-patch flags mask"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Payload fragment copied when flag 0x2 is requested; the function copies its first 6 bytes"},{"offset":292,"meaning":"2-byte payload fragment selected by flag 0x100000"},{"offset":296,"meaning":"8-byte payload fragment selected by flag 0x200000"},{"offset":304,"meaning":"4-byte payload fragment selected by flag 0x400000"},{"offset":308,"meaning":"2-byte payload fragment selected by flag 0x800000"},{"offset":310,"meaning":"10-byte payload fragment selected by flag 0x1000000"}]}
